 ## 兩次修正，不要混為一談
 
 本實驗在 2026-07-19 被修正了**兩次**，第二次是修第一次修壞的地方。
 
 ### 修正 1：事件日期從 proxy 換成官方日曆
 
 原始版本用「每月第一個週五」推算 NFP 發布日。這個 proxy 錯得有結構、不是隨機噪音：
 
 - BLS 在參考週較晚的月份會改到**第二個週五**發布
 - 遇到聯邦假期會**提前**
 - **2025-10 根本沒有發布**（政府關門取消），proxy 卻憑空生出一場
 - proxy 把每一場都放在**週五**；官方日曆的 253 場只有 237 場在週五
 
 錯的事件日期不會拋錯、不會出現 NaN，圖照樣畫得出來 —— 它只是把安靜的日子算成事件日、
 同時把真的事件日丟進對照組。這是修正存在的理由。
 
 `get_first_friday()` 已**整條移除**（不是標 deprecated），日期改由
 `volpred.data.event_dates.nfp_release_dates` 取自 BLS 官方發布日曆（ALFRED，FRED
 release id 50），且**取不到就 raise，不回退 proxy**。
 
 ### 修正 2（本輪）：accessor 的同月多筆選擇錯誤
 
 第一次修正的 accessor 對「同月多筆 release 條目」取 `max()`。ALFRED 的 release id 50
 在**六個月份**會回兩筆：前一筆是 Employment Situation 正式報告，後一筆是年度季節調整
 因子／benchmark 修訂。`max()` 選到了後者 —— 也就是**把修訂當成了就業報告**：
 
 | 月份 | 正確（正式發布） | `max()` 誤選（off-cycle 修訂） |
 |---|---|---|
 | 2006-05 | 2006-05-05 | 2006-05-08 |
 | 2012-12 | 2012-12-07 | 2012-12-12 |
 | 2013-05 | 2013-05-03 | 2013-05-06 |
 | 2020-05 | 2020-05-08 | 2020-05-11 |
 | 2024-01 | 2024-01-05 | 2024-01-10 |
 | 2024-08 | 2024-08-02 | 2024-08-21 |
 
 六個日期錯，聽起來只佔 253 場的 2%，但它剛好把 NFP-vs-週五 檢定推過 5% 分界線。
 **第一次修正因此得出了一個錯誤的「顯著→不顯著」翻轉，並據此準備了 18 條文章更正 ——
 那 18 條會把一個本來正確的結論撤回。** Codex 二審判 FAIL 擋下，未套用。
 
 根修在 `src/volpred/data/event_dates.py`（改 per-month `min()` + 13–110 天 cadence
 fail-closed 驗證，commit `305d118a3`）。
 
 **為什麼原本 42 個測試全綠卻沒抓到**：fixture 是手寫的，同月第二筆事先就被刪掉了 ——
 測試餵進去的輸入根本表達不出這個 bug。修法不是加更好的斷言，是餵真實輸入：
 `tests/test_event_dates_real_raw_response.py` 直接釘住 ALFRED 的 264 筆原始回應
 （fixture `tests/fixtures/fred_release_50_nfp_raw_20260719.json`，**禁止去重**，
 那六對重複就是迴歸面），並附 mutation 檢查證明舊 `max()` 規則會在這份輸入上失敗。
 
 ## 方法
 
 - 資料：SPY / ^VIX 日頻（yfinance），2005-01 至 2026-03
 - 事件日：BLS 官方發布日曆（ALFRED release id 50），fail-closed
 - 事件窗：T-5 ~ T-1（前）、T（當日）、T+1 ~ T+5（後）
 - 檢定：Welch t（vs 全體非 NFP 日 / vs 非 NFP 週五）、Mann-Whitney U、
   VIX 中位數分組 regime 檢定、Pearson / Spearman 相關
 
 ### 週五基準的口徑（estimand）調整
 
 事件組是**星期別混合**、對照組是**純週五**，週五本身的波動特性會直接混進 p 值。
 
 **這個缺陷不是日期修正造成的 —— 修正只是讓它被看見。** proxy 的*日曆*確實每場都是週五，
 但遇休市會映射到下一個 session，所以它實際的 254 場事件裡有 **15 場是週一**（239/254 =
 94.1% 在週五）；官方日曆是 237/253 = 93.7%。混合程度幾乎沒變，舊版一直都在拿混合事件組
 比純週五對照組，只是從來沒人注意到。
 
 本輪把事件組**限定為在週五公布的 237 場**，兩邊星期別一致。另一個選項是保留全部 253 場
 改用 weekday-matched controls，未採用的理由：非週五事件是週一 6、週二 2、週三 1、週四 7，
 用這種格數做加權平均，標準誤會被 1 筆的週三格主導 —— 那是對一個更難陳述的量做更吵的估計。
 
 **限定週五不是中性的樣本刪除，這點必須明講**：被排除的 16 場平均 |ret| 是 0.715%，比週五
 NFP 的 0.854% **低 16.3%**，所以限定之後 ratio 會被墊高（1.177× → 1.189×）。那是口徑的
 性質，不是效果變強的證據。
 
 **因此這個檢定識別的是「週五公布的 NFP」，不是「NFP 一般而言」。** 引用這個數字的文字
 必須寫「在週五公布的 NFP」。
 
 兩種口徑在 audit 中**兩邊平行呈現**（修正前後各自都算了兩種），不拿不同口徑硬比：
 
 | | 限定週五（主口徑） | 混合星期別（舊口徑） |
 |---|---|---|
-| 修正前（proxy） | 1.168× / p=0.0409 / n=239 | 1.168× / p=0.0335 / n=254（文章當初引用的） |
+| 修正前（proxy） | 1.167× / p=0.0421 / n=239 | 1.168× / p=0.0335 / n=254（文章當初引用的） |
 | 修正後（官方） | **1.189× / p=0.0209 / n=237** | 1.177× / p=0.0257 / n=253（DIAGNOSTIC ONLY） |
 
+（proxy 側的兩格對照組定義不同：限定週五那格用的是**去洩漏**的對照組 832 筆，
+「文章當初引用的」那格保留當年含洩漏的原值 —— 前者才是與修正後同口徑的比較。）
+
 **兩種口徑、修正前後，四格全部顯著** —— 「顯著→不顯著」的翻轉在任何一種讀法下都不成立。
 
 ## 結果：逐項前後對照
 
 每一項都同時看 **mean / median / 勝率 / 樣本數 / 顯著性** —— 平均值可能幾乎不動，
 而中位數與勝率在底下已經移位。
 
 兩欄使用**相同口徑**，所以差異可歸因於日期本身，不是口徑改動。
 
 | 指標 | 修正前（proxy） | 修正後（官方，本輪） | 判定 |
 |---|---|---|---|
 | 樣本數 | 254 | 253（212 個日期共通） | 數值微調 |
-| NFP vs 全體非 NFP（平均） | 1.104× (p=0.128, NS) | 1.108× (p=0.112, NS) | 數值微調 |
-| ↳ 中位數比 / 勝率 | 1.190× / 0.555 | 1.192× / 0.561 | 數值微調 |
-| 週五 NFP vs 非 NFP 週五（平均） | 1.168× (p=0.0409, **顯著**, n=239) | 1.189× (p=0.0209, **仍顯著**, n=237) | 數值微調 |
-| ↳ 中位數比 / 勝率 | 1.198× / 0.557 | 1.219× / 0.570 | 數值微調 |
+| NFP vs 全體非 NFP（平均） | 1.103× (p=0.129, NS) | 1.108× (p=0.112, NS) | 數值微調 |
+| ↳ 中位數比 / 勝率 | 1.188× / 0.555 | 1.192× / 0.561 | 數值微調 |
+| 週五 NFP vs 非 NFP 週五（平均） | 1.167× (p=0.0421, **顯著**, n=239) | 1.189× (p=0.0209, **仍顯著**, n=237) | 數值微調 |
+| ↳ 中位數比 / 勝率 | 1.198× / 0.557 | 1.218× / 0.570 | 數值微調 |
 | VIX 高低體制差（平均） | 2.167× (p=2.8e-10) | 2.027× (p=4.6e-9) | 數值微調（仍極顯著） |
 | ↳ 中位數比 / 勝率 | 2.265× / 0.717 | 2.073× / 0.695 | 數值微調 |
 | 事前 VIX 相關（Pearson） | 0.451 | 0.440 | 數值微調 |
 | ↳ Spearman | 0.377 | 0.346 | 數值微調 |
 | VIX 中位數切點 | 16.71 | 16.69 | 數值微調 |
 
 **6 項受稽核宣稱中，0 項結論翻轉。**
 
 **方向性主結論不變**：以進場 VIX 中位數分組，兩組 NFP 日的波動差距（2.03 倍、p≈4.6e-9）
 在數值上遠大於 NFP 對基準的差距（1.11 / 1.19 倍）。
 
 **這句話的邊界（不要讀過頭）**：這是**條件關聯**，不是因果識別。本實驗**沒有**正式檢定
 「2.03 倍顯著大於 1.19 倍」—— 兩者的樣本與對照組都不同，並排只是量級對照，不是統計比較。
 也不能反推「所以不是 NFP 本身」：平均差檢定沒拒絕不是零效果的證據，而排序檢定其實拒絕了
 （見上）。VIX 分組同時也是**事後**中位數分割，本身帶有樣本內成分。
 
 ### 關於「不顯著」的措辭
 
 修正前的結果檔寫過 NFP 效果 "insignificant across all tests"，但同一份檔案裡單尾
 Mann-Whitney 的 p=0.0088 明確顯著 —— 那句總結**與它自己的數字矛盾**。本輪起每個顯著性
 陳述都綁定它自己的檢定：
 
 - Welch 平均差（vs 全體非 NFP 日）：1.108×，p=0.112，**未拒絕**
 - Welch 平均差（**週五公布的 NFP** 對非 NFP 週五）：1.189×，p=0.0209，**拒絕**
   —— 條件於週五，不是關於 NFP 一般而言
 - Mann-Whitney 單尾（隨機優勢，不是平均）：p=0.0019，**拒絕**
 
 平均差檢定沒拒絕，**不等於**分佈相同，更不是效果為零的證據。|return| 厚尾，
 排序檢定抓得到平均檢定抓不到的位移。兩個都報，不合併成單一裁決。

 ## 防迴歸
 
 事件日期正確性的 owner 是 `tests/test_nfp_official_release_dates.py`（未另開新檔）：
 
 - `TestK528UsesOfficialCalendar` — 釘住 k528 用官方日曆、樣本 253 筆、237 筆在週五、
   212 個日期共通、結果檔宣告 fail-closed
 - `test_no_off_cycle_revision_date_is_treated_as_an_event` — **直接釘住 v2 BLOCKER**：
   對 artifact 斷言六個 off-cycle 日期不在事件集合、六個正式發布日在。對 artifact 而非
   只對 accessor 斷言，因為「accessor 是對的」不能證明「出貨的結果用了它」
 - `TestControlGroupHasNoNfpDays` — 釘住控制組不含任何已映射 NFP session
 - `TestCalendarFailClosedCannotBeBypassed` — 逐條釘住三審找到的繞過路徑：較早的
   off-cycle、選擇非最早、跨度內缺月、allowlist 濫用；外加一個**必須通過**的乾淨日曆
   （只會拒絕的 guard 和永不拒絕的一樣沒用）
 - `TestFridayEstimandIsScopedHonestly` — 釘住 conditional estimand 有標示、
   非中性排除有揭露、排除筆數與 weekday 分解一致（結果檔曾經散文寫 11、資料寫 16）
 - `TestProxyMutationIsCaught` — mutation test：proxy 日曆餵給 guard 必須被拒；
   只塞回幻影的 2025-10-03 也必須被抓；同時驗證 guard 不會誤殺官方日曆
 
 accessor 層的 owner 是 `tests/test_event_dates_release_selection.py` 與
 `tests/test_event_dates_real_raw_response.py`（未經編輯的 ALFRED 日期清單 + mutation 檢查）。
 後者的 scope 有明寫：它釘的是 `_fetch` 的**回傳值**（原樣、未去重），不是完整 HTTP
 response body，所以 `_fetch` 自身的 schema 破壞不在覆蓋範圍內。
 
 Mutation 已實測：把 `min()` 改回 `max()` 後 `test_regular_release_wins_in_every_duplicate_month`
 由綠轉紅（`2006-05-08 != 2006-05-05`），還原後 99 passed。沒被實際觸發過的 gate 不算 gate。
 
 ## 主腳本的 fail-closed 面
 
 **日曆完整性**（`check_calendar_is_complete`）**同時驗證 raw feed 與 accessor 的選擇**。
 只驗證 accessor 的**輸出**是行不通的：accessor 在把資料交出來之前就已經把每個月收斂成一個
 日期，等到能檢查輸出的時候，同月歧義早就被（可能錯誤地）默默解決掉了。四道關卡：
 
 0. 選擇本身要 well-formed：同一個月被選了兩次 → raise；選出來的月份/日期不存在於 raw
    feed → raise（否則後面用 `dict` 建 month→date 對照時，重複的月份會被靜默蓋掉，
    剛好蓋掉我們要找的東西）
 1. 選到的不是該月最早一筆 → raise（這正是 v2 BLOCKER 的形狀）
 2. 任何同月多筆的月份**必須列在 `REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS`**，且選到的日期要與人工
    核對過的答案一致 → 否則 raise（理由見下方「殘留限制」）
 3. 觀測跨度**沒有覆蓋到請求視窗**（頭尾任一端短少 > 70 天）→ raise。只檢查跨度「內部」
    的缺口抓不到截斷：feed 提早結束的話，跨度會跟著縮短，於是看起來什麼都不缺
 4. 觀測跨度內缺月 → raise。錨定在實際觀測跨度而非 `[start, end]`，移除了舊版
    「首尾月無條件豁免」的漏洞（完整的首月照樣可以無聲消失）
 5. `KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS` 宣稱的缺口，會回頭去 raw feed **驗證它真的是缺口** → 有資料就
    raise。沒有這一關，allowlist 就只是「讓失敗的檢查通過」的另一個名字
 
 **一個被自己的資料推翻的設計**（留著當紀錄）：這裡原本還有一關「同月兩筆間隔 < 3 天就
 視為無法辨識」，理由是「修訂都是報告後數週才報」。拿真實 feed 一跑就被推翻 —— 六個真實
 同月多筆月份裡有**三個**（2006-05、2013-05、2020-05）剛好間隔 **3 天**。真實資料橫跨在
 自己設的門檻上，那就不是安全檢查，是製造信心的旋鈕，因此整關移除。
 `tests/...::test_real_multi_entry_gaps_are_too_small_for_a_gap_rule` 把這個事實釘住，
 以免有人再發明一次同樣的規則。
 
 已知的真實缺口只有 2025-10（政府關門），每筆都要附理由字串。
 
 **殘留限制（明講，不假裝已完全關上）**：同月選擇用的「取最早一筆」是**啟發式**。它對目前
 查過的每一個案例都對，但它無法區分「比正式報告**更早**歸檔的 off-cycle 項目」與報告本身
 —— 單靠日期不可能分辨。因此規則照跑，但**額外**要求每個同月多筆的月份都出現在
 `REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS`（六個月份逐一對照 BLS news-release archive 驗證過）。
 新出現的同月多筆月份會**讓整個 run 失敗**，而不是被這支腳本自行假設掉。
 第 4、第 3 兩關是三審 round-2 進行期間自查補上的。

 def load_article_content(storage_dir: Path) -> str:
     feed = json.loads((storage_dir / "reports" / "feed.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
     art = next((a for a in feed if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id") == ARTICLE_ID), None)
     if art is None:
         raise KeyError(f"{ARTICLE_ID} not found in {storage_dir}/reports/feed.json")
     return art.get("content") or ""
 
 
 def validate(storage_dir: Path) -> list[dict]:
     """Resolve every replacement against the live article. Raises if any does
     not match exactly once, before a single byte is written."""
     from volpred.publisher.article_correction import _splice
 
     content = load_article_content(storage_dir)
     spans = _splice(content, REPLACEMENTS)
     return [
         {"index": i, "hits": 1, "from": s["from"], "to": s["to"], "offset": s["start"]}
         for i, s in enumerate(sorted(spans, key=lambda x: x["start"]))
     ]
 
 
 def _write_json_atomic(path: Path, payload) -> None:
     fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(path.parent), prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp")
     try:
         with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
             json.dump(payload, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
             f.write("\n")
             f.flush()
             os.fsync(f.fileno())
         os.replace(tmp, path)
     except BaseException:
         try:
             os.unlink(tmp)
         except FileNotFoundError:
             pass  # silent-ok: best-effort cleanup of our own temp file; the original error re-raises below
         raise
 
 
 def record_plan(validated: list[dict], applied: dict | None) -> None:
     audit = json.loads(AUDIT_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
     audit["article_correction"] = {
         "article_id": ARTICLE_ID,
         "status": "applied" if applied else "validated_not_applied",
         "n_replacements": len(REPLACEMENTS),
         "all_matched_exactly_once": True,
         "supersedes": {
             "voided_list_size": VOIDED_20260719_LIST_SIZE,
             "voided_at": "2026-07-19",
             "reason": (
                 "the 18-item list was built against a rerun whose accessor picked "
                 "off-cycle ALFRED entries for six months, which pushed the "
                 "NFP-vs-Friday test across the 5% line. It would have retracted a "
                 "finding that is in fact correct."
             ),
         },
         "directional_claims_changed": 0,
         "replacements": [{"from": v["from"], "to": v["to"], "hits": v["hits"]} for v in validated],
         "apply_result": applied,
         "residual_gap": (
             "The two inline charts (nfp_20260703_regime.png, nfp_20260703_baseline.png) "
             "and the two lazypack images still render proxy-era numbers. Text and images "
             "now disagree; the article carries a visible note saying so. Regenerating and "
             "re-uploading them is follow-up work outside this worktree's scope."
         ),
     }

 =============================================================
 Extends K513 (FOMC/NFP/CPI event study) with deeper NFP-specific analysis.
 
 K513 finding: NFP vol ratio = 1.09x (NS, p=0.195). This study digs deeper:
   - Larger sample with more granular windows
   - VIX predictive regression
   - Vol crush pattern analysis
   - Seasonal decomposition (which months matter?)
   - NFP surprise impact (FRED PAYEMS data)
 
 Data sources:
   - SPY daily OHLCV: yfinance (2005-01 to 2026-03)
   - VIX daily close: yfinance (^VIX)
   - NFP dates: OFFICIAL BLS release calendar via ALFRED (FRED release id 50)
   - NFP actual values: FRED PAYEMS (monthly, for surprise calculation)
 
 CORRECTION 2026-07-19
 ---------------------
 The original run dated every NFP to the first Friday of the month. That proxy is
 wrong for ~20% of the sample and it is wrong SYSTEMATICALLY, not randomly: BLS
 moves the release to the second Friday whenever the reference week falls late
 (28 dates land exactly 7 days early), and pulls it forward around holidays (12
 dates land 3-4 days late). It also invents a release in 2025-10 that never
 happened, and it forces every event onto a Friday when 16 of the 254 official
 releases are not on a Friday at all.
 
 Wrong event dates do not fail loudly. They count quiet days as event days and
 dump real event days into the control group, and the figures still render. So
 the dates now come from the official release calendar and the run FAILS CLOSED
 if that calendar is unreachable -- `get_first_friday` is gone, not deprecated.
 
 This script also emits a before/after comparison against the archived proxy-era
 results so the correction's effect on every published number is auditable
 (k528_nfp_official_dates_results.json).
 
 References:
   - Savor & Wilson (2013) "How Much Do Investors Care About Macroeconomic Risk?"
     JFE, core finding: scheduled macro announcements earn risk premium
   - Lucca & Moench (2015) "The Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift" JFE
   - K513: Our prior FOMC/NFP/CPI event study (2005-2025, 668 events)
   - K1442: event-date audit that found this bug
 
 Author: VolPred Research System
 Date: 2026-03-27 (corrected 2026-07-19)

 # How far the observed calendar may fall short of the requested window before the
 # run treats it as truncated. One monthly cycle plus slack; a feed that stops

 MAX_WINDOW_SHORTFALL_DAYS = 70
 
 
 def write_json_atomic(path: Path, payload) -> None:
     """Write `payload` to `path` atomically.
 
     A truncate-then-write leaves a half-written results file on the disk if the
     run dies mid-dump, and a half-written results file is worse than none: it
     still parses far enough to look like data to the next reader. Write to a
     temp file in the same directory, fsync, then os.replace (atomic on POSIX).
     """
     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
     fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(path.parent), prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp")
     try:
         with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
             json.dump(payload, f, indent=2, default=str)
             f.flush()
             os.fsync(f.fileno())
         os.replace(tmp, path)
     except BaseException:
         try:
             os.unlink(tmp)
         except FileNotFoundError:
             pass  # silent-ok: best-effort cleanup of our own temp file; the original error re-raises below
         raise

 def check_calendar_is_complete(selected, raw, start, end):
     """Fail closed on a calendar that is merely PLAUSIBLE rather than complete.
 
     "Did the call succeed?" is the wrong question. A monthly release calendar
     that silently lost 2019 still returns a non-empty list, still produces
     event windows, still renders.
 
     This validates the RAW feed as well as the accessor's per-month selection.
     Validating only the selection cannot work: the accessor collapses each month
     to one date before this function ever sees it, so a same-month ambiguity is
     already resolved -- silently, and possibly wrongly -- by the time a check on
     the output could look for it. That is precisely how the k528 v2 BLOCKER got
     through (Codex v3 finding 3).
 
     Four ways the input can be wrong without being empty, all of which raise:
       1. a month has two entries too close together to tell report from revision
       2. the selection is not the earliest entry of its month
       3. a month is missing from the observed span
       4. a month is claimed as a known hole but the raw feed actually has data
     """
     sel = [pd.Timestamp(d) for d in selected]
     sel_months = [d.strftime("%Y-%m") for d in sel]
 
     raw_by_month: dict[str, list[pd.Timestamp]] = {}
     for d in raw:
         ts = pd.Timestamp(d)
         raw_by_month.setdefault(ts.strftime("%Y-%m"), []).append(ts)
     for v in raw_by_month.values():
         v.sort()

     # from it. Building a month->date dict first would silently keep only the
     # last of a duplicated month and hide exactly what we are looking for.

     for m in sel_months:
         sel_month_counts[m] = sel_month_counts.get(m, 0) + 1
     sel_dupes = sorted(m for m, c in sel_month_counts.items() if c > 1)
     if sel_dupes:
         raise RuntimeError(
             f"selected calendar has more than one entry for {sel_dupes}. The Employment "
             "Situation is monthly; a duplicated month means the accessor stopped collapsing."
         )
     invented = sorted(set(sel_months) - set(raw_by_month))
     if invented:

             f"selected calendar contains month(s) absent from the raw feed: {invented}. "
             "The selection must be a subset of what the source actually published."

     if off_feed:
         raise RuntimeError(
             f"selected dates that do not appear in the raw feed at all: {off_feed}."
         )

 def load_nfp_dates(start=SAMPLE_START, end=SAMPLE_END):
     """Official NFP (Employment Situation) release dates.
 
     Deliberately has no except branch. If the release calendar cannot be
     reached, this run must die -- a proxy calendar produces plausible numbers
     from non-events, which is worse than no numbers at all. See the CORRECTION
     note in the module docstring.

     dates = nfp_release_dates(start, end)

         raise RuntimeError(f"official NFP calendar returned nothing for {start}..{end}")

     # date, so the only place a same-month ambiguity is still visible is here.
     raw = _fetch(RELEASE_IDS["NFP_US"], start, end)
     completeness = check_calendar_is_complete(dates, raw, start, end)
     return list(dates), completeness

 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 # Holes found by Codex v3 against commit 6fd281901. Each of these shipped once
 # with a green suite, so each gets an assertion rather than a comment.
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 
 def _k528_module():
     """Load the k528 script's functions and literal constants without running
     the analysis body (which downloads data and would need a live API key).
 
     Constants are selected by "is it a literal?", not by a hand-maintained name
     list. The name-list version silently dropped every constant added after it
     was written, and a helper that quietly omits what it is supposed to load
     makes the tests exercise something other than the production code path.
     """
     import ast
     import types
 
     def _is_literal_assignment(node):
         if not isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)) or node.value is None:
             return False
         try:
             ast.literal_eval(node.value)
         except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
             return False  # silent-ok: "is this a literal?" probe; a non-literal is the expected answer, not a failure
         return True
 
     src = K528_PY.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
     tree = ast.parse(src)
     keep = [
         n for n in tree.body
         if isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom, ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))
         or _is_literal_assignment(n)
     ]
     mod = types.ModuleType("k528_helpers")
     exec(compile(ast.Module(body=keep, type_ignores=[]), "k528", "exec"), mod.__dict__)
     # Guard the loader: if this ever silently stops loading what the tests need,
     # the tests below would pass vacuously or error confusingly.
     for required in ("check_calendar_is_complete", "KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS",
                      "REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS", "MAX_WINDOW_SHORTFALL_DAYS"):
         assert hasattr(mod, required), f"_k528_module failed to load {required}"
     return mod
 
 
 class TestControlGroupHasNoNfpDays:
     """A real NFP session sitting in the control group is the exact failure this
     experiment exists to document -- it just happened at 1/253 scale instead of
     46/254, via an event dropped for lacking a pre-window but never removed from
     the baseline."""
 
     def test_every_mapped_nfp_session_is_excluded_from_the_control_group(self):
         """Assert against an INDEPENDENTLY recorded total.
 
         The first version of this test defined total = controls + mapped and
         then asserted controls == total - mapped, which is an algebraic identity
         that passes for any value of controls -- including the leaking 5087 it
         was written to catch. A test that cannot fail is worse than no test: it
         reads as coverage. (Codex v3 round-2 finding 3.)
         """
         sample = _load_k528(K528_RESULTS)["sample"]
         audit = sample["event_mapping_audit"]
         total = sample["total_trading_days"]
         assert total == 5340, "pinned SPY session count for this sample window"
         assert sample["non_nfp_trading_days"] == total - audit["n_mapped_to_sessions"] == 5086, (
             "control group must exclude ALL mapped NFP sessions, not just the ones "
             "that survived the event-window filter (5087 was the leaking value)"
         )
         assert sample["control_group_excludes_all_nfp_sessions"] is True
 
     def test_proxy_side_control_group_is_also_clean(self):
         """The same leak existed on the proxy side of the before/after audit:
-        the archive holds the proxy's ANALYSED events, not its NFP sessions."""
-        audit = _load_k528(K528_AUDIT)
-        before = audit["items"]["vol_ratio_vs_friday"]["before"]
-        assert before["n_control_friday"] == 832, (
-            "proxy Friday control count must exclude the proxy's own "
-            "window-dropped January-2005 session"
+        the archive holds the proxy's ANALYSED events, not its NFP sessions.
+
+        Asserting `n_control_friday == 832` alone would not catch a regression
+        that re-leaks 2005-01-07 while dropping some other Friday -- the count
+        would still be 832. So reconstruct the property from the archived event
+        dates instead of restating a scalar. (Codex v3 round-3 finding 4.)
+        """
+        proxy = _load_k528(K528_DIR / "k528_nfp_event_study_results_PROXY_SUPERSEDED.json")
+        archived = {e["date"] for e in proxy["event_data"]}
+
+        # 2005-01-07 is the proxy's January-2005 event: it is the first Friday of
+        # that month AND it is absent from the archive, because the proxy's own
+        # window buffer dropped it. That combination is what made it a leak.
+        assert "2005-01-07" not in archived
+        assert _first_friday(2005, 1).isoformat() == "2005-01-07"
+
+        before = _load_k528(K528_AUDIT)["items"]["vol_ratio_vs_friday"]["before"]
+        # Fridays in the sample, minus archived Friday events, minus that one
+        # reconstructed session -- computed here, not copied from the artifact.
+        n_friday_events_archived = sum(
+            1 for d in archived if pd.Timestamp(d).weekday() == 4
         )
+        assert before["n"] == n_friday_events_archived == 239
+        assert before["n_control_friday"] == 832
+
+    def test_proxy_before_column_uses_one_control_definition_throughout(self):
+        """A `before` object whose mean comes from the leaky archive while its
+        median comes from the leak-free rebuild is not any single estimand."""
+        before = _load_k528(K528_AUDIT)["items"]["vol_ratio_vs_all"]["before"]
+        assert "as_published" in before, "the leaky published values must be nested, not inlined"
+        assert before["p_value"] != before["as_published"]["p_value"], (
+            "if these match, the top-level fields are still the archive's leaky values"
+        )
+        assert before["n_control"] == 5085
+        assert before["as_published"]["n_control"] == 5086
 
     def test_window_excluded_event_is_not_silently_analysed_or_kept_as_control(self):
         audit = _load_k528(K528_RESULTS)["sample"]["event_mapping_audit"]

     def test_off_cycle_entry_earlier_in_the_month_is_refused_not_silently_picked(self, check):

         per-month min() takes it without complaint and the cadence still passes.
         Only the reviewed-month allowlist catches this -- a day-gap threshold
         cannot, because three of the six real cases are 3 days apart."""
+        # 5 days apart, so the gap gate lets it through: only the reviewed-month
+        # allowlist can catch an off-cycle item filed BEFORE the report.

             check(
                 pd.to_datetime(["2024-01-05", "2024-02-01", "2024-03-08"]),
-                ["2024-01-05", "2024-02-01", "2024-02-02", "2024-03-08"],

                 "2024-01-01", "2024-03-31",
             )
 
     def test_real_multi_entry_gaps_are_too_small_for_a_gap_rule(self):
         """Pin the fact that killed the gap heuristic: 2006-05, 2013-05 and
         2020-05 have the revision exactly 3 days after the report. Any future
         'revisions are filed weeks later' rule is wrong on the real feed."""
         import json
 
         raw = json.loads(
             (REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "fixtures" / "fred_release_50_nfp_raw_20260719.json")
             .read_text(encoding="utf-8")
         )["release_dates"]
         by_month = {}
         for d in raw:
             by_month.setdefault(d[:7], []).append(d)
         gaps = {
             m: (pd.Timestamp(sorted(v)[1]) - pd.Timestamp(sorted(v)[0])).days
             for m, v in by_month.items() if len(v) > 1
         }
         assert min(gaps.values()) == 3, gaps
         assert sorted(m for m, g in gaps.items() if g == 3) == ["2006-05", "2013-05", "2020-05"]

 class TestFridayEstimandIsScopedHonestly:
     """Codex v3 finding 4: restricting to Friday is a legitimate conditional
     estimand, but it stops supporting statements about NFP releases in general,
     and the restriction is not a neutral sample deletion."""
 
     def test_results_scope_the_claim_to_friday_and_disclose_the_non_neutrality(self):
         b = _load_k528(K528_RESULTS)["statistical_tests"]["B_nfp_vs_friday"]
         assert "CONDITIONAL ON FRIDAY" in b["estimand"]
         assert "Friday NFP" in b["claim_scope"]
         nn = b["restriction_is_not_neutral"]
         assert nn["excluded_are_quieter_by_pct"] > 0, (
             "if the excluded events are quieter, the restriction RAISES the ratio "
             "and that must be stated, not discovered by a reviewer"
         )
 
     def test_excluded_count_matches_the_weekday_breakdown(self):
         """The results file once said 11 in prose and 16 in data."""
         results = _load_k528(K528_RESULTS)
         b = results["statistical_tests"]["B_nfp_vs_friday"]
         non_friday = sum(1 for e in results["event_data"] if e["weekday"] != 4)
         assert b["excluded_non_friday_events"]["n"] == non_friday == 16
         assert str(non_friday) in b["estimand"]

   124	def write_json_atomic(path: Path, payload) -> None:
   125	    """Write `payload` to `path` atomically.
   126	
   127	    A truncate-then-write leaves a half-written results file on the disk if the
   128	    run dies mid-dump, and a half-written results file is worse than none: it
   129	    still parses far enough to look like data to the next reader. Write to a
   130	    temp file in the same directory, fsync, then os.replace (atomic on POSIX).
   131	    """
   132	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   133	    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(path.parent), prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp")
   134	    try:
   135	        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
   136	            json.dump(payload, f, indent=2, default=str)
   137	            f.flush()
   138	            os.fsync(f.fileno())
   139	        os.replace(tmp, path)
   140	    except BaseException:
   141	        try:
   142	            os.unlink(tmp)
   143	        except FileNotFoundError:
   144	            pass  # silent-ok: best-effort cleanup of our own temp file; the original error re-raises below
   145	        raise

   151	def check_calendar_is_complete(selected, raw, start, end):
   152	    """Fail closed on a calendar that is merely PLAUSIBLE rather than complete.
   153	
   154	    "Did the call succeed?" is the wrong question. A monthly release calendar
   155	    that silently lost 2019 still returns a non-empty list, still produces
   156	    event windows, still renders.
   157	
   158	    This validates the RAW feed as well as the accessor's per-month selection.
   159	    Validating only the selection cannot work: the accessor collapses each month
   160	    to one date before this function ever sees it, so a same-month ambiguity is
   161	    already resolved -- silently, and possibly wrongly -- by the time a check on
   162	    the output could look for it. That is precisely how the k528 v2 BLOCKER got
   163	    through (Codex v3 finding 3).
   164	
   165	    Four ways the input can be wrong without being empty, all of which raise:
   166	      1. a month has two entries too close together to tell report from revision
   167	      2. the selection is not the earliest entry of its month
   168	      3. a month is missing from the observed span
   169	      4. a month is claimed as a known hole but the raw feed actually has data
   170	    """

   172	    sel_months = [d.strftime("%Y-%m") for d in sel]
   173	
   174	    raw_by_month: dict[str, list[pd.Timestamp]] = {}
   175	    for d in raw:
   176	        ts = pd.Timestamp(d)
   177	        raw_by_month.setdefault(ts.strftime("%Y-%m"), []).append(ts)
   178	    for v in raw_by_month.values():
   179	        v.sort()
   180	
   181	    # 0: the selection itself must be well-formed before anything is inferred
   182	    # from it. Building a month->date dict first would silently keep only the
   183	    # last of a duplicated month and hide exactly what we are looking for.
   184	    sel_month_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
   185	    for m in sel_months:
   186	        sel_month_counts[m] = sel_month_counts.get(m, 0) + 1
   187	    sel_dupes = sorted(m for m, c in sel_month_counts.items() if c > 1)
   188	    if sel_dupes:
   189	        raise RuntimeError(
   190	            f"selected calendar has more than one entry for {sel_dupes}. The Employment "
   191	            "Situation is monthly; a duplicated month means the accessor stopped collapsing."
   192	        )
   193	    invented = sorted(set(sel_months) - set(raw_by_month))
   194	    if invented:
   195	        raise RuntimeError(
   196	            f"selected calendar contains month(s) absent from the raw feed: {invented}. "
   197	            "The selection must be a subset of what the source actually published."
   198	        )
   199	    off_feed = sorted(str(d.date()) for d in sel if d not in raw_by_month.get(d.strftime("%Y-%m"), []))
   200	    if off_feed:

   202	            f"selected dates that do not appear in the raw feed at all: {off_feed}."
   203	        )

   206	    # same-month pair must be far enough apart to tell report from revision.

   209	    for month, entries in raw_by_month.items():
   210	        if len(entries) > 1:
   211	            gap = (entries[1] - entries[0]).days
   212	            if gap < AMBIGUOUS_SAME_MONTH_GAP_DAYS:
   213	                ambiguous.append(
   214	                    f"{month}: {entries[0].date()} vs {entries[1].date()} ({gap}d apart)"
   215	                )
   216	        if month in sel_by_month and sel_by_month[month] != entries[0]:
   217	            mis_selected.append(
   218	                f"{month}: selected {sel_by_month[month].date()}, earliest is {entries[0].date()}"
   219	            )

   221	        raise RuntimeError(
   222	            f"{len(ambiguous)} month(s) carry two release entries too close together to "
   223	            f"identify the Employment Situation report by date order: {ambiguous}. "
   224	            "Refusing to guess which one is the monthly report."

   226	    if mis_selected:

   228	            f"accessor did not select the earliest entry in {len(mis_selected)} month(s): "
   229	            f"{mis_selected}. The later same-month entry is an off-cycle revision, not the "
   230	            "monthly report -- selecting it is the k528 v2 BLOCKER."

   350	def load_nfp_dates(start=SAMPLE_START, end=SAMPLE_END):
   351	    """Official NFP (Employment Situation) release dates.
   352	
   353	    Deliberately has no except branch. If the release calendar cannot be
   354	    reached, this run must die -- a proxy calendar produces plausible numbers
   355	    from non-events, which is worse than no numbers at all. See the CORRECTION
   356	    note in the module docstring.
   357	    """
   358	    dates = nfp_release_dates(start, end)
   359	    if len(dates) == 0:
   360	        raise RuntimeError(f"official NFP calendar returned nothing for {start}..{end}")
   361	    # Pull the unselected feed as well: the accessor collapses each month to one
   362	    # date, so the only place a same-month ambiguity is still visible is here.
   363	    raw = _fetch(RELEASE_IDS["NFP_US"], start, end)
   364	    completeness = check_calendar_is_complete(dates, raw, start, end)
   365	    return list(dates), completeness

    16	publishes the actual news-release dates per statistical release, which is exactly
    17	the ground truth an event study needs.
    18	
    19	Usage:
    20	    from volpred.data.event_dates import cpi_release_dates
    21	    dates = cpi_release_dates("2024-01-01", "2026-12-31")   # DatetimeIndex

    51	def _api_key() -> str:
    52	    key = os.environ.get("FRED_API_KEY")
    53	    if key:

    55	    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    56	    for cand in (".env.local", ".env"):
    57	        p = root / cand
    58	        if not p.exists():

    62	                return line.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip("\"'")

    64	        "FRED_API_KEY not found. Event dates must come from the official release "
    65	        "calendar — do not fall back to a hard-coded list or a calendar proxy."
    66	    )
    67	
    68	
    69	def _fetch(release_id: int, start: str, end: str) -> list[str]:
    70	    r = requests.get(
    71	        "https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/release/dates",
    72	        params={
    73	            "release_id": release_id,
    74	            "api_key": _api_key(),
    75	            "file_type": "json",
    76	            "realtime_start": start,
    77	            "realtime_end": end,
    78	            # Without this, ALFRED only returns releases that already carry data, so
    79	            # scheduled-but-not-yet-published dates (the ones an upcoming-event
    80	            # populator actually needs) are missing. Verified 2026-07-12 that it does
    81	            # NOT resurrect cancelled releases: the Oct-2025 CPI, scrapped during the
    82	            # shutdown, stays absent either way.
    83	            "include_release_dates_with_no_data": "true",
    84	            "limit": 1000,
    85	            "sort_order": "asc",
    86	        },
    87	        timeout=30,
    88	    )
    89	    r.raise_for_status()
    90	    return [d["date"] for d in r.json()["release_dates"]]
    91	
    92	
    93	def release_dates(event: str, start: str, end: str, *, use_cache: bool = True) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
    94	    """Official news-release dates for `event` within [start, end].
    95	
    96	    Monthly releases can carry off-cycle entries (annual seasonal-factor and
    97	    benchmark revisions are filed against the same release id, LATER in the
    98	    month than the regular report). We therefore keep the EARLIEST entry in
    99	    each month — 2026-07-19 k528 Codex review proved the previous `max()` rule
   100	    picked 6 off-cycle dates as NFP events and flipped a significance result.
   101	
   102	    Fail-closed on ambiguity: the selected sequence must look like a monthly
   103	    release calendar (consecutive gaps 13–110 days; shutdown catch-ups compress for real,
   104	    e.g. 2013-10-22 -> 2013-11-08 = 17d, and cancelled months stretch,
   105	    e.g. 2025-09-05 -> 2025-11-20 = 76d). Any gap outside that band
   106	    raises instead of returning a plausible-but-wrong calendar —
   107	    silently-wrong event dates are worse than a failed run.
   108	    """
   109	    if event not in RELEASE_IDS:
   110	        raise KeyError(f"unknown event {event!r}; known: {sorted(RELEASE_IDS)}")
   111	
   112	    cache = _CACHE_DIR / f"{event}_{start}_{end}.json"
   113	    if use_cache and cache.exists():
   114	        age = pd.Timestamp.now(tz="UTC").tz_localize(None) - pd.Timestamp(cache.stat().st_mtime, unit="s")
   115	        if age < _CACHE_TTL:
   116	            raw = json.loads(cache.read_text())
   117	        else:
   118	            raw = None
   119	    else:
   120	        raw = None
   121	
   122	    if raw is None:
   123	        raw = _fetch(RELEASE_IDS[event], start, end)
   124	        if use_cache:
   125	            # use_cache=False must bypass the cache ENTIRELY — the old code
   126	            # skipped only the read and still wrote, which leaked canonical
   127	            # writes out of hermetic tests (CI repo-state guard, 2026-07-19).
   128	            from volpred.canonical_write import guard_canonical_write
   129	
   130	            guard_canonical_write(cache)
   131	            cache.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   132	            cache.write_text(json.dumps(raw) + "\n")
   133	
   134	    dates = pd.to_datetime(raw)
   135	    if len(dates) == 0:
   136	        raise RuntimeError(f"no {event} release dates returned for {start}..{end}")
   137	    s = pd.Series(dates, index=dates)
   138	    monthly = s.groupby([dates.year, dates.month]).min()
   139	    selected = pd.DatetimeIndex(sorted(monthly.values))
   140	    # Lower bound 13d catches mispicked entries (collapse patterns run <=12d)
   141	    # while passing real shutdown catch-ups (2013-10-22 -> 2013-11-08 = 17d).
   142	    # Upper bound 110d allows cancelled months (76d real) but trips on 3+ gaps.
   143	    gaps = pd.Series(selected).diff().dropna().dt.days
   144	    bad = gaps[(gaps < 13) | (gaps > 110)]
   145	    if len(bad) > 0:
   146	        offenders = [
   147	            f"{selected[i - 1].date()} -> {selected[i].date()} ({int(g)}d)"
   148	            for i, g in zip(bad.index, bad.values)
   149	        ]
   150	        raise RuntimeError(
   151	            f"{event} release calendar failed monthly-cadence validation "
   152	            f"(gaps outside 13-110 days): {offenders}. Off-cycle entries or "
   153	            f"missing months need manual disambiguation — refusing to return "
   154	            f"a plausible-but-wrong calendar."
   155	        )
   156	    return selected
   157	
   158	
   159	def cpi_release_dates(start: str, end: str, **kw) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
   160	    return release_dates("CPI_US", start, end, **kw)
   161	
   162	
   163	def nfp_release_dates(start: str, end: str, **kw) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
   164	    return release_dates("NFP_US", start, end, **kw)

   501	# Holes found by Codex v3 against commit 6fd281901. Each of these shipped once
   502	# with a green suite, so each gets an assertion rather than a comment.
   503	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

   505	
   506	def _k528_module():
   507	    """Load the k528 script's functions and literal constants without running
   508	    the analysis body (which downloads data and would need a live API key).
   509	
   510	    Constants are selected by "is it a literal?", not by a hand-maintained name
   511	    list. The name-list version silently dropped every constant added after it
   512	    was written, and a helper that quietly omits what it is supposed to load
   513	    makes the tests exercise something other than the production code path.
   514	    """
   515	    import ast
   516	    import types
   517	
   518	    def _is_literal_assignment(node):
   519	        if not isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)) or node.value is None:
   520	            return False
   521	        try:
   522	            ast.literal_eval(node.value)
   523	        except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
   524	            return False  # silent-ok: "is this a literal?" probe; a non-literal is the expected answer, not a failure
   525	        return True
   526	
   527	    src = K528_PY.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   528	    tree = ast.parse(src)
   529	    keep = [
   530	        n for n in tree.body
   531	        if isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom, ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))
   532	        or _is_literal_assignment(n)
   533	    ]
   534	    mod = types.ModuleType("k528_helpers")
   535	    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=keep, type_ignores=[]), "k528", "exec"), mod.__dict__)
   536	    # Guard the loader: if this ever silently stops loading what the tests need,
   537	    # the tests below would pass vacuously or error confusingly.
   538	    for required in ("check_calendar_is_complete", "KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS",
   539	                     "REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS", "MAX_WINDOW_SHORTFALL_DAYS"):
   540	        assert hasattr(mod, required), f"_k528_module failed to load {required}"
   541	    return mod

   554	        then asserted controls == total - mapped, which is an algebraic identity
   555	        that passes for any value of controls -- including the leaking 5087 it
   556	        was written to catch. A test that cannot fail is worse than no test: it
   557	        reads as coverage. (Codex v3 round-2 finding 3.)

     1	"""Regression test against the unedited ALFRED release-date feed.
     2	
     3	Why this file exists, separately from test_event_dates_release_selection.py:
     4	
     5	The 42 tests that were green when Codex reviewed k528 all fed `release_dates`
     6	a *hand-built* fixture in which the same-month duplicate entries had already
     7	been removed. So they exercised the selection rule against input that could
     8	not express the bug. The old per-month `max()` rule shipped 6 wrong NFP event
     9	dates and flipped a significance result with a fully green suite.
    10	
    11	The fix for a fixture that cannot express the bug is not a better assertion —
    12	it is real input. This module pins the unedited return value of `_fetch` for
    13	release id 50 (Employment Situation, 2005-01-01..2026-07-19, 264 entries) and
    14	asserts the six regular releases survive selection.
    15	
    16	SCOPE — what this fixture is and is not (Codex v3 finding 6): it is `_fetch`'s
    17	output, i.e. the `release_dates[].date` list exactly as the live API returned
    18	it on 2026-07-19, with nothing removed. It is NOT the full HTTP response body,
    19	so it does not cover JSON envelope changes, pagination, or field renames — a
    20	schema break in `_fetch` itself would not be caught here. What it does cover is
    21	the selection semantics downstream of `_fetch`, which is where the k528 bug was.

  1186	def verdict_for(key):
  1187	    """Flip test: significance change, sign change, or a >10% move in the headline."""
  1188	    b, a = audit_items[key]["before"], audit_items[key]["after"]
  1189	    reasons = []
  1190	    if b.get("significant_5pct") is not None and a.get("significant_5pct") is not None:
  1191	        if bool(b["significant_5pct"]) != bool(a["significant_5pct"]):
  1192	            reasons.append(
  1193	                "significance flipped "
  1194	                f"({'sig' if b['significant_5pct'] else 'NS'} -> "
  1195	                f"{'sig' if a['significant_5pct'] else 'NS'})"
  1196	            )
  1197	    # The mean is not trusted on its own: the median and the win rate are
  1198	    # checked independently, because the failure mode this audit exists to
  1199	    # catch is a stable mean sitting on top of a moved distribution.
  1200	    for field in ("mean_ratio", "median_ratio", "pearson_r", "threshold", "n"):
  1201	        if field in b and field in a and b[field] and a[field]:
  1202	            rel = abs(a[field] - b[field]) / abs(b[field])
  1203	            if rel > 0.10:
  1204	                reasons.append(f"{field} moved {rel * 100:.1f}%")
  1205	    if b.get("win_rate") and a.get("win_rate"):
  1206	        if abs(a["win_rate"] - b["win_rate"]) > 0.05:
  1207	            reasons.append(
  1208	                f"win_rate moved {b['win_rate']:.3f} -> {a['win_rate']:.3f}"
  1209	            )
  1210	    if key == "vix_median_threshold" and b["places_20260701_vix_1659_in"] != a["places_20260701_vix_1659_in"]:
  1211	        reasons.append("the article's worked example changes regime")
  1212	    return ("CONCLUSION_FLIPPED" if reasons else "NUMERIC_ADJUSTMENT"), reasons
  1213	
  1214	
  1215	print(f"\n  {'Claim':<46} {'Before':>12} {'After':>12}  Verdict")
  1216	for key, item in audit_items.items():
  1217	    v, reasons = verdict_for(key)
  1218	    item["verdict"], item["verdict_reasons"] = v, reasons
  1219	    headline = next((f for f in ("mean_ratio", "pearson_r", "threshold", "n")
  1220	                     if f in item["before"]), None)
  1221	    bf = item["before"].get(headline)
  1222	    af = item["after"].get(headline)
  1223	    fmt = (lambda x: f"{x:,.4f}" if isinstance(x, float) else str(x))
  1224	    print(f"  {item['label']:<46} {fmt(bf):>12} {fmt(af):>12}  {v}")
  1225	    for r in reasons:
  1226	        print(f"      - {r}")
  1227	
  1228	n_flipped = sum(1 for i in audit_items.values() if i["verdict"] == "CONCLUSION_FLIPPED")
  1229	print(f"\n  {n_flipped} of {len(audit_items)} audited claims changed materially.")

     1	# k528 — NFP 事件研究（SPY 波動率）
     2	
     3	- Experiment ID: `k528`
     4	- Created At: 2026-04-16T09:39:52.904348+00:00
     5	- Corrected At: 2026-07-19（事件日期來源修正，全樣本重跑；同日第二次修正見下）
     6	- Status: 已重跑，**方向性結論全部不變**，僅數值微調 + 一項口徑澄清
     7	
     8	## 問題描述
     9	
    10	NFP（非農就業）公布日，SPY 的波動是否會系統性放大？如果會，放大的來源是「NFP 這個
    11	事件本身」，還是「進場當下的市場狀態」？
    12	
    13	## 兩次修正，不要混為一談
    14	
    15	本實驗在 2026-07-19 被修正了**兩次**，第二次是修第一次修壞的地方。
    16	
    17	### 修正 1：事件日期從 proxy 換成官方日曆
    18	
    19	原始版本用「每月第一個週五」推算 NFP 發布日。這個 proxy 錯得有結構、不是隨機噪音：
    20	
    21	- BLS 在參考週較晚的月份會改到**第二個週五**發布
    22	- 遇到聯邦假期會**提前**
    23	- **2025-10 根本沒有發布**（政府關門取消），proxy 卻憑空生出一場
    24	- proxy 把每一場都放在**週五**；官方日曆的 253 場只有 237 場在週五
    25	
    26	錯的事件日期不會拋錯、不會出現 NaN，圖照樣畫得出來 —— 它只是把安靜的日子算成事件日、
    27	同時把真的事件日丟進對照組。這是修正存在的理由。
    28	
    29	`get_first_friday()` 已**整條移除**（不是標 deprecated），日期改由
    30	`volpred.data.event_dates.nfp_release_dates` 取自 BLS 官方發布日曆（ALFRED，FRED
    31	release id 50），且**取不到就 raise，不回退 proxy**。
    32	
    33	### 修正 2（本輪）：accessor 的同月多筆選擇錯誤
    34	
    35	第一次修正的 accessor 對「同月多筆 release 條目」取 `max()`。ALFRED 的 release id 50
    36	在**六個月份**會回兩筆：前一筆是 Employment Situation 正式報告，後一筆是年度季節調整
    37	因子／benchmark 修訂。`max()` 選到了後者 —— 也就是**把修訂當成了就業報告**：
    38	
    39	| 月份 | 正確（正式發布） | `max()` 誤選（off-cycle 修訂） |
    40	|---|---|---|
    41	| 2006-05 | 2006-05-05 | 2006-05-08 |
    42	| 2012-12 | 2012-12-07 | 2012-12-12 |
    43	| 2013-05 | 2013-05-03 | 2013-05-06 |
    44	| 2020-05 | 2020-05-08 | 2020-05-11 |
    45	| 2024-01 | 2024-01-05 | 2024-01-10 |
    46	| 2024-08 | 2024-08-02 | 2024-08-21 |
    47	
    48	六個日期錯，聽起來只佔 253 場的 2%，但它剛好把 NFP-vs-週五 檢定推過 5% 分界線。
    49	**第一次修正因此得出了一個錯誤的「顯著→不顯著」翻轉，並據此準備了 18 條文章更正 ——
    50	那 18 條會把一個本來正確的結論撤回。** Codex 二審判 FAIL 擋下，未套用。
    51	
    52	根修在 `src/volpred/data/event_dates.py`（改 per-month `min()` + 13–110 天 cadence
    53	fail-closed 驗證，commit `305d118a3`）。
    54	
    55	**為什麼原本 42 個測試全綠卻沒抓到**：fixture 是手寫的，同月第二筆事先就被刪掉了 ——
    56	測試餵進去的輸入根本表達不出這個 bug。修法不是加更好的斷言，是餵真實輸入：
    57	`tests/test_event_dates_real_raw_response.py` 直接釘住 ALFRED 的 264 筆原始回應
    58	（fixture `tests/fixtures/fred_release_50_nfp_raw_20260719.json`，**禁止去重**，
    59	那六對重複就是迴歸面），並附 mutation 檢查證明舊 `max()` 規則會在這份輸入上失敗。
    60	
    61	## 方法
    62	
    63	- 資料：SPY / ^VIX 日頻（yfinance），2005-01 至 2026-03
    64	- 事件日：BLS 官方發布日曆（ALFRED release id 50），fail-closed
    65	- 事件窗：T-5 ~ T-1（前）、T（當日）、T+1 ~ T+5（後）
    66	- 檢定：Welch t（vs 全體非 NFP 日 / vs 非 NFP 週五）、Mann-Whitney U、
    67	  VIX 中位數分組 regime 檢定、Pearson / Spearman 相關
    68	
    69	### 週五基準的口徑（estimand）調整
    70	
    71	事件組是**星期別混合**、對照組是**純週五**，週五本身的波動特性會直接混進 p 值。
    72	
    73	**這個缺陷不是日期修正造成的 —— 修正只是讓它被看見。** proxy 的*日曆*確實每場都是週五，
    74	但遇休市會映射到下一個 session，所以它實際的 254 場事件裡有 **15 場是週一**（239/254 =
    75	94.1% 在週五）；官方日曆是 237/253 = 93.7%。混合程度幾乎沒變，舊版一直都在拿混合事件組
    76	比純週五對照組，只是從來沒人注意到。
    77	
    78	本輪把事件組**限定為在週五公布的 237 場**，兩邊星期別一致。另一個選項是保留全部 253 場
    79	改用 weekday-matched controls，未採用的理由：非週五事件是週一 6、週二 2、週三 1、週四 7，
    80	用這種格數做加權平均，標準誤會被 1 筆的週三格主導 —— 那是對一個更難陳述的量做更吵的估計。
    81	
    82	**限定週五不是中性的樣本刪除，這點必須明講**：被排除的 16 場平均 |ret| 是 0.715%，比週五
    83	NFP 的 0.854% **低 16.3%**，所以限定之後 ratio 會被墊高（1.177× → 1.189×）。那是口徑的
    84	性質，不是效果變強的證據。
    85	
    86	**因此這個檢定識別的是「週五公布的 NFP」，不是「NFP 一般而言」。** 引用這個數字的文字
    87	必須寫「在週五公布的 NFP」。
    88	
    89	兩種口徑在 audit 中**兩邊平行呈現**（修正前後各自都算了兩種），不拿不同口徑硬比：
    90	
    91	| | 限定週五（主口徑） | 混合星期別（舊口徑） |
    92	|---|---|---|
    93	| 修正前（proxy） | 1.167× / p=0.0421 / n=239 | 1.168× / p=0.0335 / n=254（文章當初引用的） |
    94	| 修正後（官方） | **1.189× / p=0.0209 / n=237** | 1.177× / p=0.0257 / n=253（DIAGNOSTIC ONLY） |
    95	
    96	（proxy 側的兩格對照組定義不同：限定週五那格用的是**去洩漏**的對照組 832 筆，
    97	「文章當初引用的」那格保留當年含洩漏的原值 —— 前者才是與修正後同口徑的比較。）
    98	
    99	**兩種口徑、修正前後，四格全部顯著** —— 「顯著→不顯著」的翻轉在任何一種讀法下都不成立。
   100	
   101	## 結果：逐項前後對照
   102	
   103	每一項都同時看 **mean / median / 勝率 / 樣本數 / 顯著性** —— 平均值可能幾乎不動，
   104	而中位數與勝率在底下已經移位。
   105	
   106	兩欄使用**相同口徑**，所以差異可歸因於日期本身，不是口徑改動。
   107	
   108	| 指標 | 修正前（proxy） | 修正後（官方，本輪） | 判定 |
   109	|---|---|---|---|
   110	| 樣本數 | 254 | 253（212 個日期共通） | 數值微調 |
   111	| NFP vs 全體非 NFP（平均） | 1.103× (p=0.129, NS) | 1.108× (p=0.112, NS) | 數值微調 |
   112	| ↳ 中位數比 / 勝率 | 1.188× / 0.555 | 1.192× / 0.561 | 數值微調 |
   113	| 週五 NFP vs 非 NFP 週五（平均） | 1.167× (p=0.0421, **顯著**, n=239) | 1.189× (p=0.0209, **仍顯著**, n=237) | 數值微調 |
   114	| ↳ 中位數比 / 勝率 | 1.198× / 0.557 | 1.218× / 0.570 | 數值微調 |
   115	| VIX 高低體制差（平均） | 2.167× (p=2.8e-10) | 2.027× (p=4.6e-9) | 數值微調（仍極顯著） |
   116	| ↳ 中位數比 / 勝率 | 2.265× / 0.717 | 2.073× / 0.695 | 數值微調 |
   117	| 事前 VIX 相關（Pearson） | 0.451 | 0.440 | 數值微調 |
   118	| ↳ Spearman | 0.377 | 0.346 | 數值微調 |
   119	| VIX 中位數切點 | 16.71 | 16.69 | 數值微調 |
   120	
   121	**6 項受稽核宣稱中，0 項結論翻轉。**
   122	
   123	**方向性主結論不變**：以進場 VIX 中位數分組，兩組 NFP 日的波動差距（2.03 倍、p≈4.6e-9）
   124	在數值上遠大於 NFP 對基準的差距（1.11 / 1.19 倍）。
   125	
   126	**這句話的邊界（不要讀過頭）**：這是**條件關聯**，不是因果識別。本實驗**沒有**正式檢定
   127	「2.03 倍顯著大於 1.19 倍」—— 兩者的樣本與對照組都不同，並排只是量級對照，不是統計比較。
   128	也不能反推「所以不是 NFP 本身」：平均差檢定沒拒絕不是零效果的證據，而排序檢定其實拒絕了
   129	（見上）。VIX 分組同時也是**事後**中位數分割，本身帶有樣本內成分。
   130	
   131	### 關於「不顯著」的措辭
   132	
   133	修正前的結果檔寫過 NFP 效果 "insignificant across all tests"，但同一份檔案裡單尾
   134	Mann-Whitney 的 p=0.0088 明確顯著 —— 那句總結**與它自己的數字矛盾**。本輪起每個顯著性
   135	陳述都綁定它自己的檢定：
   136	
   137	- Welch 平均差（vs 全體非 NFP 日）：1.108×，p=0.112，**未拒絕**
   138	- Welch 平均差（**週五公布的 NFP** 對非 NFP 週五）：1.189×，p=0.0209，**拒絕**
   139	  —— 條件於週五，不是關於 NFP 一般而言
   140	- Mann-Whitney 單尾（隨機優勢，不是平均）：p=0.0019，**拒絕**
   141	
   142	平均差檢定沒拒絕，**不等於**分佈相同，更不是效果為零的證據。|return| 厚尾，
   143	排序檢定抓得到平均檢定抓不到的位移。兩個都報，不合併成單一裁決。
   144

   156	
   157	## 線上文章更正（`mile_35eef830`）
   158	
   159	### ⚠️ 原 18 條更正清單已全數作廢
   160	
   161	原清單是對著**被污染的 JSON** 建的，且包含一個**錯誤的方向翻轉**（把「達到顯著水準」
   162	改寫成「p=0.057，差一點過線但沒過」）。文章原本寫的是對的；套用那 18 條等於發佈一則

   165	
   166	### 新清單：19 條，全部是數值重述，0 條方向翻轉
   167	
   168	文章原始的三個方向性判讀 —— 對全體交易日基準未達顯著、對週五基準達到顯著、進場 VIX
   169	高低兩組的差距是本研究中最大的數字 —— 在官方日期下**全部成立**（第三點的邊界見上文
   170	「這句話的邊界」：是量級並排，不是排名，也未做正式比較）。新清單只改數字
   171	（1.10→1.11、1.17→1.19、2.17→2.03、0.45→0.44、254→253、16.71→16.69 等），

   176	```bash

   181	
   182	**為什麼不在 worktree 內直接寫**：`storage/reports/feed.json` 是共享 canonical 狀態，
   183	`.claude/rules/worktree.md` 明文禁止 worktree agent 觸碰。這不是形式規定 —— 本 worktree
   184	自帶一份 15MB 的 feed.json 複本，在這裡寫等於寫進一份「其他文章一發佈就過期」的分支複本，
   185	合併回去會把期間發佈的文章靜默蓋掉。因此拆成：worktree 負責解析與驗證，主線程負責寫入。
   186	
   187	**未解決的缺口**：文中兩張圖表（`nfp_20260703_regime.png`、`nfp_20260703_baseline.png`）
   188	與文末兩張懶人包圖仍是修正前的數據，圖片內容無法用文字替換修正。更正後正文與圖片會不一致，
   189	因此更正說明中已明寫「圖表仍是初版數據，正在重新產製」。重新產圖 + 上傳 Supabase 屬後續工作。
   190	
   191	## 防迴歸
   192	
   193	事件日期正確性的 owner 是 `tests/test_nfp_official_release_dates.py`（未另開新檔）：
   194	
   195	- `TestK528UsesOfficialCalendar` — 釘住 k528 用官方日曆、樣本 253 筆、237 筆在週五、
   196	  212 個日期共通、結果檔宣告 fail-closed
   197	- `test_no_off_cycle_revision_date_is_treated_as_an_event` — **直接釘住 v2 BLOCKER**：
   198	  對 artifact 斷言六個 off-cycle 日期不在事件集合、六個正式發布日在。對 artifact 而非
   199	  只對 accessor 斷言，因為「accessor 是對的」不能證明「出貨的結果用了它」
   200	- `TestControlGroupHasNoNfpDays` — 釘住控制組不含任何已映射 NFP session
   201	- `TestCalendarFailClosedCannotBeBypassed` — 逐條釘住三審找到的繞過路徑：較早的
   202	  off-cycle、選擇非最早、跨度內缺月、allowlist 濫用；外加一個**必須通過**的乾淨日曆
   203	  （只會拒絕的 guard 和永不拒絕的一樣沒用）
   204	- `TestFridayEstimandIsScopedHonestly` — 釘住 conditional estimand 有標示、
   205	  非中性排除有揭露、排除筆數與 weekday 分解一致（結果檔曾經散文寫 11、資料寫 16）
   206	- `TestProxyMutationIsCaught` — mutation test：proxy 日曆餵給 guard 必須被拒；
   207	  只塞回幻影的 2025-10-03 也必須被抓；同時驗證 guard 不會誤殺官方日曆
   208	
   209	accessor 層的 owner 是 `tests/test_event_dates_release_selection.py` 與
   210	`tests/test_event_dates_real_raw_response.py`（未經編輯的 ALFRED 日期清單 + mutation 檢查）。
   211	後者的 scope 有明寫：它釘的是 `_fetch` 的**回傳值**（原樣、未去重），不是完整 HTTP
   212	response body，所以 `_fetch` 自身的 schema 破壞不在覆蓋範圍內。
   213	
   214	Mutation 已實測：把 `min()` 改回 `max()` 後 `test_regular_release_wins_in_every_duplicate_month`
   215	由綠轉紅（`2006-05-08 != 2006-05-05`），還原後 99 passed。沒被實際觸發過的 gate 不算 gate。
   216	
   217	## 主腳本的 fail-closed 面
   218	
   219	**日曆完整性**（`check_calendar_is_complete`）**同時驗證 raw feed 與 accessor 的選擇**。
   220	只驗證 accessor 的**輸出**是行不通的：accessor 在把資料交出來之前就已經把每個月收斂成一個
   221	日期，等到能檢查輸出的時候，同月歧義早就被（可能錯誤地）默默解決掉了。四道關卡：
   222	
   223	0. 選擇本身要 well-formed：同一個月被選了兩次 → raise；選出來的月份/日期不存在於 raw
   224	   feed → raise（否則後面用 `dict` 建 month→date 對照時，重複的月份會被靜默蓋掉，
   225	   剛好蓋掉我們要找的東西）
   226	1. 選到的不是該月最早一筆 → raise（這正是 v2 BLOCKER 的形狀）
   227	2. 任何同月多筆的月份**必須列在 `REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS`**，且選到的日期要與人工
   228	   核對過的答案一致 → 否則 raise（理由見下方「殘留限制」）
   229	3. 觀測跨度**沒有覆蓋到請求視窗**（頭尾任一端短少 > 70 天）→ raise。只檢查跨度「內部」
   230	   的缺口抓不到截斷：feed 提早結束的話，跨度會跟著縮短，於是看起來什麼都不缺
   231	4. 觀測跨度內缺月 → raise。錨定在實際觀測跨度而非 `[start, end]`，移除了舊版
   232	   「首尾月無條件豁免」的漏洞（完整的首月照樣可以無聲消失）
   233	5. `KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS` 宣稱的缺口，會回頭去 raw feed **驗證它真的是缺口** → 有資料就
   234	   raise。沒有這一關，allowlist 就只是「讓失敗的檢查通過」的另一個名字
   235	
   236	**一個被自己的資料推翻的設計**（留著當紀錄）：這裡原本還有一關「同月兩筆間隔 < 3 天就
   237	視為無法辨識」，理由是「修訂都是報告後數週才報」。拿真實 feed 一跑就被推翻 —— 六個真實
   238	同月多筆月份裡有**三個**（2006-05、2013-05、2020-05）剛好間隔 **3 天**。真實資料橫跨在
   239	自己設的門檻上，那就不是安全檢查，是製造信心的旋鈕，因此整關移除。
   240	`tests/...::test_real_multi_entry_gaps_are_too_small_for_a_gap_rule` 把這個事實釘住，
   241	以免有人再發明一次同樣的規則。
   242	
   243	已知的真實缺口只有 2025-10（政府關門），每筆都要附理由字串。
   244	
   245	**殘留限制（明講，不假裝已完全關上）**：同月選擇用的「取最早一筆」是**啟發式**。它對目前
   246	查過的每一個案例都對，但它無法區分「比正式報告**更早**歸檔的 off-cycle 項目」與報告本身
   247	—— 單靠日期不可能分辨。因此規則照跑，但**額外**要求每個同月多筆的月份都出現在
   248	`REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS`（六個月份逐一對照 BLS news-release archive 驗證過）。
   249	新出現的同月多筆月份會**讓整個 run 失敗**，而不是被這支腳本自行假設掉。
   250	第 4、第 3 兩關是三審 round-2 進行期間自查補上的。
   251	
   252	**事件日→交易日對映**：一對一完整性斷言。樣本內發布日找不到三日內交易日 → raise；
   253	兩個發布日映射到同一個 session → raise（原本的 `set()` 去重會把這件事藏起來並靜默減少
   254	事件數）。窗口邊界排除改為明確記錄在 `sample.event_mapping_audit`，不再靜默 `continue`。
   255	
   256	**控制組不含任何 NFP session**：對照組排除**全部 254 個**已映射 NFP session，不只是通過
   257	事件窗篩選的 253 個。因窗口不足被排除的 `2005-01-07` 仍然是真實的 NFP 日，把它留在對照組
   258	就是本實驗存在的理由（「把真的事件日丟進對照組」）的 1/253 版本。三審 Codex 與本輪自查
   259	獨立發現同一件事。
   260	
   261	**原子寫入**：主結果與 audit 皆走 temp file + `fsync` + `os.replace`。
   262

     1	"""Build and validate the in-place correction to mile_35eef830.
     2	
     3	The article was published 2026-07-01 with headline numbers taken from K528,
     4	which dated every NFP to the first Friday of the month. On the official BLS
     5	calendar that proxy is wrong for ~20% of the sample, so every number moved a
     6	little. This script restates them.
     7	
     8	WHAT CHANGED SINCE THE VOIDED 2026-07-19 CORRECTION LIST
     9	--------------------------------------------------------
    10	An earlier 18-item list was built against a contaminated rerun and has been
    11	VOIDED IN FULL. That rerun used an event-date accessor which, for the six
    12	months where ALFRED returns two entries, picked the LATER one -- an off-cycle
    13	seasonal-factor revision rather than the Employment Situation report. Six event
    14	dates were therefore wrong (2006-05-08, 2012-12-12, 2013-05-06, 2020-05-11,
    15	2024-01-10, 2024-08-21).
    16	
    17	That mattered far more than six dates out of 253 suggests, because it moved the
    18	NFP-vs-Friday test across the 5% line. The voided list told readers that a
    19	result the article reported as significant was in fact not significant
    20	(1.17x p=0.0335 -> "1.15x p=0.057, 差一點過線但沒過"). On correct dates the
    21	comparison is 1.19x at p=0.020 -- significant, exactly as the article
    22	originally said. Applying that list would have published a retraction of a
    23	correct finding.
    24	
    25	So: no claim in this article reverses direction. Every replacement below is a
    26	numeric restatement, plus one estimand refinement that is disclosed in the note.
    27	
    28	THE ONE ESTIMAND CHANGE
    29	-----------------------
    30	The event group is a weekday mixture while the control group is pure Friday, so
    31	the Friday effect leaks into the estimate. The corrected test restricts the
    32	event group to the 237 Friday releases.
    33	
    34	Note against the tempting story: this defect was NOT introduced by the date
    35	correction. The proxy CALENDAR was all-Friday by construction, but mapping
    36	holiday-closed Fridays to the next open put 15 of its 254 events on a Monday
    37	(239/254 = 94.1% Friday, against 237/253 = 93.7% now). The old spec was already
    38	comparing a mixed group against a pure-Friday control; correcting the dates is
    39	what made it visible, not what caused it.
    40	
    41	Two consequences the article text must respect:
    42	  1. The test now identifies the effect of an NFP release ON A FRIDAY. Prose
    43	     quoting it says "在週五公布的 NFP", not "NFP".
    44	  2. The restriction is not a neutral deletion — the excluded events are 16.3%
    45	     quieter, so restricting RAISES the ratio (1.177x -> 1.189x). Both numbers
    46	     are disclosed in the correction note rather than only the flattering one.
    47	
    48	WHY THIS SCRIPT DOES NOT WRITE BY DEFAULT
    49	-----------------------------------------
    50	`storage/reports/feed.json` is shared canonical state. `.claude/rules/worktree.md`
    51	forbids a worktree agent from touching it, and the reason is mechanical rather
    52	than ceremonial: this worktree carries its own 15MB checkout of feed.json, so a
    53	write here lands on a branch copy that is already stale the moment any other
    54	article is published, and merging it would silently revert them.
    55	
    56	So the split is: this script (run from the worktree) resolves and VALIDATES
    57	every replacement against the canonical article, proving each matches exactly
    58	once before anything is written. The main thread then runs it with --apply from
    59	the repo root, where the write is legitimate.
    60	
    61	    uv run python experiments/k528/build_article_correction.py            # validate, writes nothing
    62	    uv run python experiments/k528/build_article_correction.py --apply    # write + sync
    63	
    64	Validation uses `article_correction._splice`, the same resolver the writer
    65	uses, so a plan that validates here cannot fail differently there.
    66	"""

   211	def load_article_content(storage_dir: Path) -> str:
   212	    feed = json.loads((storage_dir / "reports" / "feed.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   213	    art = next((a for a in feed if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id") == ARTICLE_ID), None)
   214	    if art is None:
   215	        raise KeyError(f"{ARTICLE_ID} not found in {storage_dir}/reports/feed.json")
   216	    return art.get("content") or ""
   217	
   218	
   219	def validate(storage_dir: Path) -> list[dict]:
   220	    """Resolve every replacement against the live article. Raises if any does
   221	    not match exactly once, before a single byte is written."""
   222	    from volpred.publisher.article_correction import _splice
   223	
   224	    content = load_article_content(storage_dir)
   225	    spans = _splice(content, REPLACEMENTS)
   226	    return [
   227	        {"index": i, "hits": 1, "from": s["from"], "to": s["to"], "offset": s["start"]}
   228	        for i, s in enumerate(sorted(spans, key=lambda x: x["start"]))
   229	    ]
   230	
   231	
   232	def _write_json_atomic(path: Path, payload) -> None:
   233	    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(path.parent), prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp")
   234	    try:
   235	        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
   236	            json.dump(payload, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
   237	            f.write("\n")
   238	            f.flush()
   239	            os.fsync(f.fileno())
   240	        os.replace(tmp, path)
   241	    except BaseException:
   242	        try:
   243	            os.unlink(tmp)
   244	        except FileNotFoundError:
   245	            pass  # silent-ok: best-effort cleanup of our own temp file; the original error re-raises below
   246	        raise
   247	
   248	
   249	def record_plan(validated: list[dict], applied: dict | None) -> None:
   250	    audit = json.loads(AUDIT_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
   251	    audit["article_correction"] = {
   252	        "article_id": ARTICLE_ID,
   253	        "status": "applied" if applied else "validated_not_applied",
   254	        "n_replacements": len(REPLACEMENTS),
   255	        "all_matched_exactly_once": True,
   256	        "supersedes": {
   257	            "voided_list_size": VOIDED_20260719_LIST_SIZE,
   258	            "voided_at": "2026-07-19",
   259	            "reason": (
   260	                "the 18-item list was built against a rerun whose accessor picked "
   261	                "off-cycle ALFRED entries for six months, which pushed the "
   262	                "NFP-vs-Friday test across the 5% line. It would have retracted a "
   263	                "finding that is in fact correct."
   264	            ),
   265	        },
   266	        "directional_claims_changed": 0,
   267	        "replacements": [{"from": v["from"], "to": v["to"], "hits": v["hits"]} for v in validated],
   268	        "apply_result": applied,
   269	        "residual_gap": (
   270	            "The two inline charts (nfp_20260703_regime.png, nfp_20260703_baseline.png) "
   271	            "and the two lazypack images still render proxy-era numbers. Text and images "
   272	            "now disagree; the article carries a visible note saying so. Regenerating and "
   273	            "re-uploading them is follow-up work outside this worktree's scope."
   274	        ),
   275	    }
   276	    _write_json_atomic(AUDIT_PATH, audit)
   277	
   278	
   279	def main() -> int:
   280	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
   281	    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true",
   282	                    help="write the correction (main thread, repo root only)")
   283	    ap.add_argument("--record-plan", action="store_true",
   284	                    help="record the validated plan into the audit JSON without applying it")
   285	    ap.add_argument("--storage-dir", default=str(REPO_ROOT / "storage"))
   286	    args = ap.parse_args()
   287	
   288	    storage_dir = Path(args.storage_dir)
   289	    validated = validate(storage_dir)
   290	    print(f"validated {len(validated)}/{len(REPLACEMENTS)} replacements, each matched exactly once")
   291	    for v in validated:
   292	        head = v["from"].splitlines()[0][:64]
   293	        print(f"  @{v['offset']:>6}  {head}...")
   294	
   295	    applied = None
   296	    if args.apply:
   297	        from volpred.publisher.article_correction import apply_article_correction
   298	
   299	        applied = apply_article_correction(
   300	            ARTICLE_ID,
   301	            content_replacements=REPLACEMENTS,
   302	            summary=(
   303	                "K528 event dates corrected from a first-Friday proxy to the official BLS "
   304	                "release calendar. Sample 254 -> 253 events; headline numbers restated "
   305	                "(1.10->1.11x vs all days, 1.17->1.19x vs Friday, 2.17->2.03x regime gap, "
   306	                "r 0.45->0.44). No directional conclusion changes. The Friday comparison "
   307	                "now restricts the event group to the 237 Friday releases so weekday is "
   308	                "held fixed on both sides."
   309	            ),
   310	            action="content_correction",
   311	            storage_dir=str(storage_dir),
   312	        )
   313	        print(f"\napplied: {len(applied['content_replacements'])} replacements, "
   314	              f"synced={applied['synced']}")
   315	
   316	    # A dry run that rewrites the audit file is not a dry run (k528 Codex v2
   317	    # finding 7). Recording is opt-in and never implicit.
   318	    if args.apply or args.record_plan:
   319	        record_plan(validated, applied)
   320	        print(f"plan recorded in {AUDIT_PATH.name}")
   321	    else:
   322	        print("\ndry run -- nothing written. Re-run with --apply from the repo root, "
   323	              "or --record-plan to persist the validated plan only.")
   324	    return 0
   325	
   326	
   327	if __name__ == "__main__":
   328	    raise SystemExit(main())

   243	已知的真實缺口只有 2025-10（政府關門），每筆都要附理由字串。
   244	
   245	**殘留限制（明講，不假裝已完全關上）**：同月選擇用的「取最早一筆」是**啟發式**。它對目前
   246	查過的每一個案例都對，但它無法區分「比正式報告**更早**歸檔的 off-cycle 項目」與報告本身
   247	—— 單靠日期不可能分辨。因此規則照跑，但**額外**要求每個同月多筆的月份都出現在
   248	`REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS`（六個月份逐一對照 BLS news-release archive 驗證過）。
   249	新出現的同月多筆月份會**讓整個 run 失敗**，而不是被這支腳本自行假設掉。
   250	第 4、第 3 兩關是三審 round-2 進行期間自查補上的。
   251	
   252	**事件日→交易日對映**：一對一完整性斷言。樣本內發布日找不到三日內交易日 → raise；
   253	兩個發布日映射到同一個 session → raise（原本的 `set()` 去重會把這件事藏起來並靜默減少
   254	事件數）。窗口邊界排除改為明確記錄在 `sample.event_mapping_audit`，不再靜默 `continue`。
   255	
   256	**控制組不含任何 NFP session**：對照組排除**全部 254 個**已映射 NFP session，不只是通過
   257	事件窗篩選的 253 個。因窗口不足被排除的 `2005-01-07` 仍然是真實的 NFP 日，把它留在對照組
   258	就是本實驗存在的理由（「把真的事件日丟進對照組」）的 1/253 版本。三審 Codex 與本輪自查
   259	獨立發現同一件事。
   260	
   261	**原子寫入**：主結果與 audit 皆走 temp file + `fsync` + `os.replace`。
   262	
   263	## 參考

日曆 gate 已找到一條新的可重現後門：`KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS` 的「raw 確實無資料」驗證只掃 selected 的 `min..max`；若把尾端 raw 月份同時列入 `KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS`，並在多筆時也列入 `REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS`，它會先被 dropped 檢查豁免、又因落在 span 外避開 bogus 檢查。這正是兩清單交互作用造成的 bypass。我接著會用 commit helper 實跑證明，並檢查是否還有統計/文字層的新退步。
exec
/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run python - <<'PY'
import ast, subprocess, types
src=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','3098ad5b5:experiments/k528/k528_nfp_event_study.py'], text=True)
tree=ast.parse(src)
def literal(n):
    if not isinstance(n,(ast.Assign,ast.AnnAssign)) or n.value is None:return False
    try: ast.literal_eval(n.value); return True
    except (ValueError,SyntaxError): return False
keep=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom,ast.FunctionDef,ast.ClassDef)) or literal(n)]
mod=types.ModuleType('k528_commit_3098ad5b5')
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=keep,type_ignores=[]),'k528_commit_3098ad5b5','exec'),mod.__dict__)

def run(name, selected, raw, missing=None, reviewed=None):
    old_m=dict(mod.KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS); old_r=dict(mod.REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS)
    try:
        if missing: mod.KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS.update(missing)
        if reviewed: mod.REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS.update(reviewed)
        try:
            out=mod.check_calendar_is_complete(mod.pd.to_datetime(selected),raw,'2024-01-01','2024-03-31')
            print(name, 'ACCEPTED', out['window_coverage'], out['months_with_multiple_raw_entries'])
        except Exception as e:
            print(name, 'RAISED', type(e).__name__, str(e)[:180])
    finally:
        mod.KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS.clear(); mod.KNOWN_MISSING_MONTHS.update(old_m)
        mod.REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS.clear(); mod.REVIEWED_MULTI_ENTRY_MONTHS.update(old_r)
run('baseline_missing_raw_month', ['2024-01-05','2024-02-02'], ['2024-01-05','2024-02-02','2024-03-08'])
run('tail_month_whitelisted_missing', ['2024-01-05','2024-02-02'], ['2024-01-05','2024-02-02','2024-03-08'], {'2024-03':'fabricated cancellation'})
run('tail_multi_month_in_both_lists', ['2024-01-05','2024-02-02'], ['2024-01-05','2024-02-02','2024-03-08','2024-03-15'], {'2024-03':'fabricated cancellation'}, {'2024-03':{'raw':['2024-03-08','2024-03-15'],'report':'2024-03-08'}})

storage/publication_candidates.json:112216:      "verdict_preview": "[提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] SPY-GLD 跨資產相關性 regime 分析。5340 日數據。\n\n核心發現：(1) 相關性確實 VIX-regime 依賴 (Kruskal-Wallis H=242, p<0.001)：low VIX corr=-0.009, medium +0.115, high +0.076, crisis -0.032。(2) 但 Newey-West HAC 後不顯著 (t=0.87, p=0.39)——serial correlation 膨脹了 OLS t 值。\n\n最重要發現：**VIX-correlation beta sign 跨年代翻",
storage/memory/knowledge.json.backup_2026_05_08_pre_k936_fix:1845:    "created_at": "2026-03-15T22:25:28.350862",

storage/memory/knowledge.json.backup_2026_05_08_pre_k936_fix:15415:    "content": "[提出: 用戶, 執行: Claude] K534: Cross-Asset Correlation Regime Dependence (SPY-GLD, 2005-2026, N=5340). 60d rolling corr: mean=0.058, range [-0.63, 0.70]. VIX regime: KW H=242 (p<0.001) — corr IS regime-dependent. BUT: (1) NW HAC regression: t=0.87, p=0.39 — NOT significant after serial correlation correction. (2) Sub-period beta sign FLIPS: 2005-2014 negative, 2015-2026 positive — structurally unstable. (3) Quadratic R²=2.4% >> linear 0.1%: inverted-U shape. (4) Full-sample DM: regime beats fixed 60/40 (p=0.002), BUT cross-OOS inconsistent — OOS3 regime WORSE (p=0.001). Classic overfitting. (5) GLD on worst SPY days: positive only 43.8% — not crash hedge. Conclusion: 50/50 robustness explained — correlation dynamics exist but are UNPREDICTABLE (sign flips, too weak, OOS fails). Builds on K443 (copula) and K444 (DCC). Refs: Engle(2002), Patton(2006), Baur&Lucey(2010).",
storage/memory/knowledge.json.backup_2026_05_08_pre_k936_fix:15435:    "content": "[提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] SPY-GLD 跨資產相關性 regime 分析。5340 日數據。\n\n核心發現：(1) 相關性確實 VIX-regime 依賴 (Kruskal-Wallis H=242, p<0.001)：low VIX corr=-0.009, medium +0.115, high +0.076, crisis -0.032。(2) 但 Newey-West HAC 後不顯著 (t=0.87, p=0.39)——serial correlation 膨脹了 OLS t 值。\n\n最重要發現：**VIX-correlation beta sign 跨年代翻轉**：2005-2014 負值（高VIX→低相關）、2015-2026 正值（高VIX→高相關）。關係結構不穩定。\n\nQuadratic fit (R²=2.4%) 20x better than linear——inverted-U shape。GLD 在 SPY 最差 5% 日只有 43.8% 正報酬，不是可靠 crash hedge。\n\nCross-OOS portfolio backtest 失敗：OOS3 regime 反而更差 (p=0.001)。\n\n**理論貢獻**：50/50 不可動搖不是因為相關性穩定，而是因為相關性動態不可預測。beta sign flip + R²<3% + cross-OOS 失敗 → 任何 regime-switching 規則都無法 exploit。",

   304	    "Welch mean-difference, Friday NFP vs Friday non-NFP (CONDITIONAL ON FRIDAY, weekday held fixed): 1.19x, p=0.0209 (rejects at 5%; n=237 vs 834). Scoped to Friday releases; the 16 non-Friday events are quieter, so this is not a statement about NFP releases in general.",

   310	  "practical_implication": "The VIX-regime gap is the LARGEST NUMBER in this study, which is not the same as being the dominant effect and is not a causal statement: 2.03x between high- and low-VIX NFP days (p=4.553e-09). The NFP-day effect itself is smaller and the tests do not agree on it -- the Welch mean-difference test against all non-NFP days gives 1.11x (p=0.1121) while the one-sided Mann-Whitney gives p=0.00194. Report both. A mean test that does not reject is not evidence that the effect is zero, and it does not license the claim that the event 'is not NFP itself'. The two magnitudes are NOT formally compared: different samples, different control groups, no test of whether the regime gap exceeds the NFP gap, and the VIX split is an in-sample median. Read them side by side, not as a ranking.",

5	1	所以精確的講法是：在週五公布的 NFP 確實比一般週五抖一點，差距顯著但不算誇張（1.19 倍）；但如果拿全部交易日當對照，這個放大效果（1.11 倍）連統計顯著都談不上。

**2026-07-19 更正說明**：本文初版的 NFP 日期是用「每月第一個週五」推算的。與 BLS 官方發布日曆比對後，約兩成對不上——參考週較晚時 BLS 會改在第二個週五發布，遇到假期則會提前，2025 年 10 月更因聯邦政府關門根本沒有發布（初版把這天算成了事件日，但那天並不存在）。改用官方日曆重跑後，樣本從 254 場變成 253 場。

**方向性結論全部維持不變**：對全體交易日基準未達顯著、對週五基準達到顯著、進場 VIX 高低兩組之間的差距是本研究中最大的數字——這三點在官方日期下都成立，只有數值小幅調整（1.10→1.11 倍、1.17→1.19 倍、2.17→2.03 倍、相關係數 0.45→0.44）。要說明的是，本文並沒有正式檢定「2.03 倍顯著大於 1.19 倍」——兩者的樣本與對照組都不同，而且 VIX 分組用的是事後中位數切點。兩個數字是並排比較量級，不是排名，也不是因果宣稱。

另有一項口徑調整：週五基準的比較，事件組原本是全部樣本（星期別混合）、對照組卻只有週五，兩邊不對等。現改為只取在週五公布的 237 場，維持兩邊星期別一致，所以該數字講的是「在週五公布的 NFP」而非 NFP 一般而言。被排掉的 16 場本身比較平靜，因此限定週五會把倍數墊高一些（不限定為 1.18 倍、限定為 1.19 倍），兩個數字都列出以免只揭露比較好看的那個。
